title: Janus
tagline: AI agent to help user to understand cryto movement with both onchain and offchain insight
description: A chat-based AI agent, deployed on Fetch.ai Agentverse and accessed via ASI:one, that synthesizes on-chain data from Blockscout with real-world news from the Tavily AI search API. The agent will help users understand crypto market movements, identify on-chain anomalies, and potentially spot new opportunities.
how_its_made:
Fetch live blockchain data using the Blockscout Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Search the web for relevant news and context using Tavily AI.
Reason using a Large Language Model (LLM) via OpenRouter to synthesize information and answer user questions in a natural, conversational way. The integration was smooth thanks to the good documentation and support from both Innovation Lab and also Blockspot. I wish I had time to try the knowledge base capability, or explore more blockscout MCP capabilities if not because of the AWS outage. But I can clearly see the potential how these technology can be used together and deliver value to more use cases.
